reason: This is a user-facing UI utility plugin for DSH Web that introduces a session-level button to expand or collapse all reasoning and tool chains, implemented in the browser client by observing and toggling disclosure rows in the current conversation view; based on available evidence, it is best classified as a navigation/control interface enhancement with no external data-processing or automation outside the session UI.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web 插件，在会话头部提供一键“展开全部/收起全部”按钮，用于切换当前会话中所有思维链与工具链的展开状态。
summaries.en: This is a DSH Web plugin that adds a one-click Expand/Collapse button to the conversation header to toggle all reasoning and tool chains in the current session.

capabilities: Adds a one-click control in the DSH web conversation header to expand or collapse all reasoning and tool disclosure rows
Scans conversation UI DOM nodes to determine current expansion state before toggling
Triggers row toggles via click events and listens for aria-expanded changes to sync button state
Runs as a web client plugin via DSH bundle/client configuration
Provides no backend API calls or external service integration in the provided manifest

reasons.code: The plugin is described as a DSH Web GUI extension adding a header button for "展开全部/收起全部" and no-source-modification UI behavior.
It is implemented as a DSH bundle with web client metadata (dsh.bundle and dsh.client platform web), indicating browser-side execution only.
Repository metadata and topic indicate a plugin package intended for direct end-user installation in DSH.
